name: io.github.IronSecCo/ironclaw
description: Sandboxed shell exec for MCP clients: run untrusted agent commands in a gVisor container.

runtimeArguments.name: --rm
runtimeArguments.description: Remove the container when the MCP session ends (ephemeral by design).

runtimeArguments.name: -i
runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open for the MCP stdio transport.

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Forward the control-plane URL from your own environment into the container; the value never appears in this listing.

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Forward the control-plane API token from your own environment into the container; the value never appears in this listing.

environmentVariables.name: IRONCLAW_CONTROLPLANE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your running IronClaw control-plane, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787. This image is a thin client with no host privilege: it delegates every sandbox_exec run to the control-plane, which owns the hardened gVisor launch. Unset means no backend and the tool fails closed.

environmentVariables.name: IRONCLAW_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the control-plane API (the value the control-plane was started with).
